module.purpose: Provides rate-limiting enforcement helpers for the Cal.com API. It wraps a generic rate limiter and, when limits are exceeded, either throws a tRPC TOO_MANY_REQUESTS error or, for SMS flows, locks the offending user or team in the database via Prisma.
module.summary: This module defines two exported functions that enforce rate limits on API operations. checkRateLimitAndThrowError delegates to a shared rateLimiter with a configurable limiting type (defaulting to 'core'), optionally invokes an onRateLimiterResponse callback, and throws a TRPCError with code TOO_MANY_REQUESTS and a retry hint in seconds when the limit is exceeded. checkSMSRateLimit uses the same limiter with an 'sms' default type, but instead of throwing, it changes the SMS lock state of the identified user or team via the internal changeSMSLockState helper. That helper parses identifiers of the form 'sms:user:<id>' or 'sms:team:<id>', looks up the corresponding Prisma User or Team record (skipping entities already reviewed by an admin), and updates their smsLockState to LOCKED or REVIEW_NEEDED depending on the rate-limiting type.
module.businessContext: Protects Cal.com's API and SMS-sending features from abuse by throttling excessive requests. SMS overuse can incur costs or spam; failing here means abuse protections and SMS lockdown safeguards stop working.
